component.name: Breadcrumb
component.description: An ordered list of navigation links separated by chevron-right icons. The last item is the current page (non-linked, default text colour). Accepts items as an array of { label, href? }.

useWhen: Showing the user's location within the page hierarchy below the AppHeader
Any page more than one level deep from the root that benefits from a back-navigation trail

notFor.case: A page at the top of the hierarchy
notFor.because: A one-item trail (just the current page) adds no wayfinding.

useWhen.default: Ordered trail of linked items with a non-linked current page label.

patterns.name: page-header-trail
patterns.useWhen: A page more than one level deep needs a trail back up, placed above its title.
